class.name: IfcTimeSeriesValue
class.brief_description: A time series value is a list of values that comprise the time series. At least one value must be supplied. Applications are expected to normalize values by applying the following three rules: All time (universal, local, daylight savings, and solar) is normalized against the ISO 8601 standard GMT/UTC (Universal Coordinated Time). Any rollover is handled by the application providing the data. Rollo

members.member: A list of time-series values. At least one value is required.
